title: "Search measured usage"
description: "Search delayed measured spend, not live enforcement counters or invoices. Principal filters select the scope; there is no target. With no user_id or agent_id filter, the scope is the authenticated user. A single-value EQUALS user_id filter must name the caller. A single-value EQUALS agent_id filter, with no user_id filter, must name a top-level agent the caller can currently edit, including disabled agents, and measures that agent. Any other principal filter needs an organization read, so like other-user, subagent, and principal-dimension requests it is accepted structurally but returns 403 insufficient_permissions. Unknown product and feature values remain in OTHER; absent attribution remains null. Results, totals, and cursor pages share one pinned read snapshot. Totals cover observed stored rows, not certified exports or verified absent usage. AGENT uses app-compatible best-effort recorded top-agent/root attribution and same-run AGENT/LLM_CALL events, not complete run lineage. Source freshness and earliest historical coverage are null when unsupported. Usage billed in GCU on full-consumption plans isn't reported yet and is excluded from results and totals. A month whose source rows exceed 200,000 at the day and user detail the query needs, or whose source read exceeds its size, billed-byte or 30-second limit, returns 422 unprocessable_query; use a coarser granularity, fewer dimensions, or a shorter range."

Search delayed measured spend, not live enforcement counters or invoices. Principal filters select the scope; there is no target. With no user_id or agent_id filter, the scope is the authenticated user. A single-value EQUALS user_id filter must name the caller. A single-value EQUALS agent_id filter, with no user_id filter, must name a top-level agent the caller can currently edit, including disabled agents, and measures that agent. Any other principal filter needs an organization read, so like other-user, subagent, and principal-dimension requests it is accepted structurally but returns 403 insufficient_permissions. Unknown product and feature values remain in OTHER; absent attribution remains null. Results, totals, and cursor pages share one pinned read snapshot. Totals cover observed stored rows, not certified exports or verified absent usage. AGENT uses app-compatible best-effort recorded top-agent/root attribution and same-run AGENT/LLM_CALL events, not complete run lineage. Source freshness and earliest historical coverage are null when unsupported. Usage billed in GCU on full-consumption plans isn't reported yet and is excluded from results and totals. A month whose source rows exceed 200,000 at the day and user detail the query needs, or whose source read exceeds its size, billed-byte or 30-second limit, returns 422 unprocessable_query; use a coarser granularity, fewer dimensions, or a shorter range.
